title: 第23章 赴难勇蚁
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
在讲台上，金教习把【砺勇石】又放了出来，让它悬在空中。

    【砺勇石】绕着前面那几只比较有天赋的蚁，慢慢地转着圈。

    满堂几百道呼吸，都跟着那块石头，一寸一寸地悬在空中。

    终于~

    它停了。

    停在王健那只蚁的头顶。

    从石头里出来的暗金色能量，犹如一滴滴融化的金水....

    无声无息地融入到那只蚁的身体之中。

    讲台上，【砺勇石】发出的光，越来越黯淡。

    渡完所有能量之后，就变成了普通的石头，回到了金教习的手心里。

    下一秒。

    蚂蚁身体里面发出金光。

    前面有崽子没绷住，失声喊了半句：

    “渡过去了！把能量都渡……”

    话还没说完的时候，就急忙捂住了自己的嘴巴。

    光晕中，那只蚁的身体，也在以肉眼可见的速度进行着变化。

    旧壳一寸一寸地爆开，新的甲壳也在下面生长着，春天的笋芽在夜空中一节接着一节地生长。

    旁边的有人压住嗓子：

    “这就是进化？”

    “这光过去...应该就可以变成一只【无惧蚁】了吧？”

    众人议论纷纷，隐藏在下面的羡慕怎么也压制不住。

    他们都知道。

    那是头天赋极高的蚁。

    王健扔出去的一百两银子，并不是白扔的。

    但是不知道为什么，虽然大家在议论，但是还是有很多目光，偷偷地往学堂最后一排望去。

    有一位穿粗布衣服的少年坐在那儿。

    少年低着头，并且没有动。

    桌子上那个蚁，也没有动。

    ...

    金色的光芒。正在慢慢的消失。

    所有人顿时安静下来。

    王健的桌面上，那枚普通的赴死蚁已经不见了。

    取而代之的，是一个全身覆盖着金色红色甲壳的战蚁，大小正好是半个巴掌。

    两条前肢变成了两把镰刀，锋利而冰冷。

    它只是趴在桌子上，一动不动，浑身的气势，便压得人不敢跟它对视。

    更奇怪的是。

    附近的几张桌子上，那几只【赴死蚁】，竟齐齐伏下了身子，触须贴着地，瑟瑟缩成一团。

    像田间里的虫蚁，撞见了官道上过境的兵。

    “【赴难勇蚁】…”

    不知道是谁，先把这四个字说了出来。

    满堂，顿时响起一片压抑不住的吸气声。

    不少崽子的眼睛，都直了。

    有崽子拽了拽同桌的衣袖，咬着耳朵：

    “你还记得冯教习说的吗？”

    “走【无惧蚁】那条的，熬一辈子，顶了天，也还是只蝼蚁，无非个头大些。”

    “可走【赴难勇蚁】这条的...往上再熬，熬出来的，是能撼动山岳的真兽。”

    同桌倒吸一口冷气，看着金红甲壳之后，眼神就不一样了。

    蝼蚁和真兽。

    这是完全不同的阶级。

    这是多么难得的造化！
content_en:
On the podium, Professor Jin released the [Strengthening Stone] again and let it hang in the air.

[Hardening Stone] slowly circled around the more talented ants in front.

Hundreds of breaths filled the hall, all following the stone, hanging in the air inch by inch.

Finally~

It stopped.

It stopped on top of Wang Jian's ant.

The dark golden energy coming out of the stone is like drops of melted gold water...

Silently integrated into the ant's body.

On the podium, the light from the [Hardening Stone] became increasingly dim.

After all the energy was transferred, it turned into an ordinary stone and returned to Jin Jiaoxi's hand.

The next second.

The inside of the ant's body glowed golden.

There was a boy in front who didn't hold back and shouted half a sentence:

"It's over! Pass all the energy..."

Before he finished speaking, he hurriedly covered his mouth.

In the halo, the ant's body was also changing at a speed visible to the naked eye.

The old shell burst open inch by inch, and the new carapace was growing underneath. The spring shoots grew one after another in the night sky.

Someone next to him lowered his voice:

"Is this evolution?"

"When this light passes...you should be able to turn into a [Fearless Ant], right?"

Everyone was talking, and the envy hidden underneath could not be suppressed.

They all know it.

That is an extremely talented ant.

The one hundred taels of silver Wang Jian threw out was not in vain.

But I don’t know why, although everyone was talking, there were still many eyes secretly looking towards the last row of the school.

There was a young man in coarse cloth sitting there.

The young man lowered his head and did not move.

The ant on the table didn't move either.

...

Golden light.It's slowly disappearing.

Everyone suddenly became quiet.

On Wang Jian's desktop, the ordinary dying ant has disappeared.

Instead, there was a war ant covered with a golden-red carapace, the size of which was exactly half a palm.

The two forelimbs turned into two sickles, sharp and cold.

It just lay on the table, motionless, and its aura was so overwhelming that no one dared to look at it.

Even stranger.

On several nearby tables, the "Death Ants" all crouched down, their tentacles touching the ground, huddled together.

Like insects and ants in the field, they bumped into soldiers passing by on the official road.

"[Brave Ant in Disaster]..."

I don’t know who said these four words first.

The whole hall suddenly heard an unsuppressed intake of breath.

The eyes of many bastards were straightened.

A kid tugged on the sleeves of his deskmate and bit his ear:

"Do you still remember what Professor Feng said?"

"Those who take the [Fearless Ant] route will live their whole lives and stand up to the sky, but they will still be just ants, just bigger."

"You can take the [Brave Ant in Disaster] route... go up and endure it, and what emerges will be a real beast that can shake the mountain."

The deskmate took a breath of air, and after looking at the golden and red carapace, his eyes were different.

Ants and real beasts.

This is a completely different class.

What a rare blessing this is!
